evidence.reason: Added a post-setup governed-cancellation recheck immediately before spawnImpl in the claude-code CLI transport: on abort it deletes the per-run MCP config and returns the 'aborted' verdict with the existing sessionId, so an abort that fires during the session/manifest/CLI-resume-id/MCP-config awaits can no longer launch a CLI child and incur client-side spend (tests not run — command patterns here do not permit the test runner).
